creators.name: Dr Leslie Tay (ieatishootipost)
creators.followers: Award-winning food blog since 2006 + YouTube channel

attach.note: Dr Leslie Tay reviewed the ex-Hyatt manager's Seremban-style lai fen (cuttlefish bee hoon) and pork curry, corroborating Eatbook and Seth Lui.
ieatishootipost documented Douglas Ng's handmade yellowtail fishballs and the young-hawker economics behind the Michelin Bib Gourmand stall.
Tony Boey's dedicated Circuit Road post on Tian Seng's old-school fried Hokkien/prawn mee.
Johor Kaki traced the Tai Thong Crescent bak chor mee stall to its master-apprentice lineage.
SG Food on Foot's 2024 revisit of the Tai Thong Crescent minced-meat noodle inside Sin Keng Seng coffeeshop.
